column1: # UTF-8；左列为代码中的原文标识，右列为游戏内显示的简体中文。不要翻译 INI 键名。
Walk, jog or run in the direction the camera faces.
column2: 沿镜头朝向步行、慢跑或奔跑。

column1: Press with the mouse over one of your characters to control them instead.
column2: 鼠标指向己方角色时按下此键，切换控制对象。

column1: Puts the camera in your character's eyes. Press again to return to the shoulder camera started by V.
column2: 切换到角色视线，再按一次返回 V 模式越肩镜头。

column1: Moves the third-person camera to the other shoulder.
column2: 将越肩镜头切换到另一侧。

column1: Hold SHIFT and press this key to toggle sneaking in first person or the third-person camera.
column2: 在第一人称或越肩视角中，按住 Shift 再按此键切换潜行。

column1: Directional mode: interacts with the nearby automatically selected target. Keyboard mode uses this key to attack.
column2: 方向模式下与附近自动选中的目标交互；键盘模式下使用此键攻击。

column1: Manual combat only. Hold to guard; in directional mode the incoming direction must match.
column2: 仅手动战斗使用；方向模式下按住并选择匹配来袭的方向。

column1: Scales how fast your character moves with the movement keys. 1.0 = the game's normal speed.
column2: 调整按移动键时的速度；1.0 为游戏正常速度。

column1: Cap speed at the character's real max
On: injuries, heavy loads and shackles slow you down exactly as they would in normal play.
column2: 开启后，受伤、负重和镣铐会按原版规则降低速度。

column1: Enemies chase and hit a moving player
column2: 敌人可追击移动中的玩家

column1: On: enemies run you down and attack a moving character. Off: the old behaviour, where enemies stall against a moving player.
column2: 开启后，敌人可追上并攻击正在移动的角色。
背包打开时镜头转向角色

column1: Off: the camera stays put and you can keep moving with the movement keys while looting or trading.
column2: 关闭后，搜刮或交易时镜头保持原位，并可继续用移动键控制角色；V 手动模式另有背包控制规则。
攻击输入保留时间（毫秒）

column1: If your character cannot swing the instant you press (still turning, just stopped moving), the press is kept for this long.
column2: 角色转身或刚停下而无法立即攻击时，在这段时间内保留攻击输入。

column1: After a swing ends, a buffered next attack waits this long before it starts, so the follow-through remains visible.
column2: 挥刀结束后，已缓存的下一击会等待这段时间再开始，使收招保持可见。

column1: On: V enables player-controlled attacks and guards. Off: combat returns to the game's AI.
column2: 开启后，V 模式由玩家控制攻击和格挡；关闭则交还游戏战斗 AI。
第一人称／越肩鼠标方向战斗

column1: Hold left mouse and move to choose a direction; release to attack. Right mouse cancels the pending attack into guard.
column2: 按住左键并移动鼠标选择方向，松开后攻击；右键取消待发攻击并转入格挡。
自动格挡（AI 决定方向）

column1: Off: hold right mouse and choose the matching direction. On: hold right mouse to request a guard while Kenshi's combat AI chooses the direction; releasing it stops the request.
column2: 关闭：按住右键并选择匹配来袭的方向；开启：按住右键发出格挡请求，由 Kenshi 原版战斗 AI 选择方向；松开即停止请求。
键盘格挡最长时间（毫秒）

column1: Applies when DirectionalCombat is off. Mouse right-button guard lasts until you release it.
column2: 仅关闭方向战斗时适用；鼠标右键格挡会持续到松开。

column1: Counted from the moment a guard ends. Letting go and pressing again right away keeps the same guard instead of starting this wait.
column2: 从格挡结束时开始计算；刚松开就再次按下，会延续原有格挡。

column1: In first person and the third-person camera, the enemy nearest the crosshair within this cone is the one your character fights.
column2: 第一人称和越肩视角下，在此角度范围内选取最接近准星的目标。

column1: In the normal camera, an enemy this close to the mouse cursor on screen becomes the one your character fights. Right-click an enemy to pick one at any distance.
column2: 普通镜头下，屏幕上靠近鼠标的敌人可成为目标；右键点击敌人也可指定目标。
重复按键忽略时间（毫秒）

column1: A second press of the same combat key this soon after the first is ignored, so a nervous double-tap never restarts a move.
column2: 同一战斗键在这段时间内再次按下会被忽略，避免误触连按重启动作。
显示 NPC 名称与生命状态

column1: The NPC directly under the crosshair gets their name and full two-row, eight-part health panel.
column2: 准星直接覆盖的 NPC 会显示名称与完整的两行八部位生命面板。

column1: How far back the shoulder camera sits. The mouse wheel zooms while it is active.
column2: 越肩镜头距离角色多远；在该视角中可用滚轮缩放。

column1: Height of the point the camera looks at. Higher looks over the shoulder; lower looks at the back.
column2: 镜头注视点的高度；调高更接近越肩视角，调低则看向后背。

column1: Positive = over the right shoulder, negative = over the left. The swap-shoulder key flips it in play.
column2: 正值偏向右肩，负值偏向左肩；游戏中可用切换越肩侧按键翻转。

column1: Used when a wall pushes the camera in close. Lower keeps your character's body intact at point-blank range; higher sees through nearby walls sooner.
column2: 墙壁把镜头推近时使用；数值较低可保留更多角色身体，较高则更早透过近处墙面。

column1: How fast the view turns with the mouse.
column2: 鼠标移动时镜头转动的速度。

column1: Wider shows more of your surroundings. Applies instantly.
column2: 数值越大，画面左右和上下能看到的范围越广；调整后立即生效。

column1: How far you can look to each side of your body before the body turns to follow the view.
column2: 视线可向身体两侧转动的角度；超过后身体会跟随转向。

column1: Softens mouse look. 0 = raw and snappy, higher = smoother but slightly delayed.
column2: 降低鼠标视角抖动；0 最灵敏，数值越高越平滑，但略有延迟。

column1: Erases your head so it never blocks the view. Leave on unless a modded race looks wrong.
column2: 隐藏自身头部，避免遮挡视野；若模组种族显示异常可关闭。

column1: Only for modded races that render wrong with the normal hide. Takes effect the next time you enter first person.
column2: 仅供普通隐藏方式不适用的模组种族使用；下次进入第一人称时生效。

column1: Headgear and beards would otherwise sit in front of the lens.
column2: 防止帽子和胡须挡住第一人称镜头。

column1: Stops the hand-on-head and hand-on-wound animations covering the view when hurt.
column2: 受伤时不让捂头和捂伤口动作遮住镜头。

column1: Show floors below you in buildings
Inside buildings, keeps the storeys below you drawn so stairs and balconies do not open onto nothing.
column2: 在建筑内保留下方楼层画面，避免楼梯和阳台下方变为空白。

column1: Fine-tunes eye level. Negative raises the eye slightly.
column2: 微调眼睛高度；负值会略微抬高视点。

column1: Added on top of the drop above, for races with unusual heads.
column2: 在眼位微调基础上进一步抬高，适用于头部比例特殊的种族。

column1: Keeps the view out of the inside of the skull. Raise if you see your own face.
column2: 避免镜头进入头骨内部；若看见自己的面部，可适当调高。

column1: The jog animation leans the body into the view; this pushes the eye ahead of it.
column2: 慢跑动作会让身体向镜头倾斜；此项将视点向前推。

column1: Same as above for the run animation.
column2: 与慢跑前移相同，但用于奔跑动作。

column1: Keeps the shoulder out of view when you look to the side.
column2: 侧看时让肩膀远离镜头，减少遮挡。

column1: Clears the arms and weapon from the view while swinging.
column2: 挥刀时把镜头向前推，减少手臂与武器遮挡。

column1: Anything closer than this to the eye is not drawn. Lower shows more of your own body but makes distant grass shimmer when you turn; higher is the reverse. 1.0 is the balance.
column2: 比此距离更靠近镜头的物体不会显示；调低可看到更多自身身体，但远处草地转头时可能闪烁。1.0 为折中值。

column1: Used while knocked down, ragdolled or getting up, when the horizon does not matter: low enough that your own body stays solid in front of the lens.
column2: 倒地、布娃娃状态或起身时使用；较低数值可让镜头前的身体保持完整。

column1: Body is solid from the inside
Draws your own body double-sided in first person, so a head pressed into the chest sees cloth and skin instead of a hollow shell.
column2: 第一人称中双面绘制自己的身体，避免镜头贴近胸口时看到空壳。

column1: Writes every combat and movement event to RE_Kenshi_log.txt. Leave off normally; turn on when asked for a log, reproduce the problem, then send the file.
column2: 将战斗和移动事件写入 RE_Kenshi_log.txt；平时可关闭，排查问题时开启并复现。
